keys.doc: hosts a worker may reach; [] denies all but the provider, ['*'] allows all; lists union across layers; enforced by the filtering proxy or the sandbox
keys.name: default_network

keys.doc: environment variable NAMES passed to the worker; nothing else leaks (G2)
keys.name: default_env_allowlist

keys.doc: where a worker runs; external engines are coerced to sandbox (v94-F4)
keys.name: default_execution_mode

keys.doc: run budget: wall clock; also the worker's per-command cap (v115-F6)
keys.name: default_wall_clock_seconds

keys.doc: run budget: planning iterations
keys.name: default_max_iterations

keys.doc: run budget: tool actions
keys.name: default_max_actions

keys.doc: run budget: LLM provider calls
keys.name: default_max_provider_calls

keys.doc: argv prefixes a worker may run without a card; remote-git and sudo prefixes are refused at every write (dangerous_prefix_reason) and filtered on every read
keys.name: allowed_shell_commands

keys.doc: runtime plugin risk classes a worker may load
keys.name: allowed_plugin_risks

keys.doc: grants git.stage/git.commit in the disposable worktree; never push/pull/fetch
keys.name: allow_git_mutation

keys.doc: the maintain lane: land a worker patch that G10 confirmed, without a card
keys.name: auto_apply_verified_patch

keys.doc: the integration branch auto-applied patches accumulate on (skep/<slug>); main never advances
keys.name: auto_apply_branch

keys.doc: a run matching the project policy exactly dispatches without a card
keys.name: auto_dispatch_allowed

keys.doc: zero-ask project (ADR 0061): decide() answers a sandboxed worker's default command asks (never a host no rule names, D42); dispatch and verified landing need no card
keys.name: unlocked

keys.doc: directories under which workspace mode is trusted; the repo and managed clones are added by construction
keys.name: trusted_workspace_roots

keys.doc: how the builtin worker plans (ADR 0040); validated at resolve time
keys.name: worker_protocol

keys.doc: the command G10 re-runs; unset falls back to the worker's own nomination (a claim) — the maintain lane refuses to land on an unpinned verify
keys.name: verify_command

keys.doc: which agent runs coding tasks (ADR 0047); external engines are sandbox-only and need a pinned verify_command
keys.name: coding_engine

keys.doc: loopback ports this project's sandboxed workers may reach (D6); loopback is otherwise closed but for a local provider's own port; serve's port never opens
keys.name: loopback_ports

keys.doc: a codex run with no OPENAI_API_KEY uses the operator's ChatGPT plan login: an access-token-only, read-only copy only that run's sandbox can read, never the refresh token (docs/codex-chatgpt-login.md)
keys.name: codex_chatgpt_login

keys.doc: ADR 0068: a sandboxed worker and its G10 re-run read an allowlist — system dirs, detected toolchains, the worktree and git metadata, extra_read_paths — not the whole disk; on for new sandboxed projects where the backend enforces it (bubblewrap, Seatbelt), existing ones migrate with `skep project setup <repo> --strict-reads`
keys.name: strict_read_confinement

keys.doc: absolute paths a strict-read run may also read (ADR 0068), resolved at every run; the secret floor still masks inside them
keys.name: extra_read_paths

keys.doc: names of attached policy groups, live-composed between phase and project (ADR 0048)
keys.name: policy_groups

keys.doc: P1 kill switch (ADR 0053 D6): the scopes whose knobs and rules answer from policy engine v2; every other scope keeps the v1 path. Flips are recorded in <audit>/policy/engine-flips.jsonl. A fresh home is seeded with filesystem+shell (ADR 0054 A6); an existing home keeps its switch
keys.name: policy_engine_v2_scopes

keys.doc: ADR 0062 kill switch: on (default), a sandboxed builtin worker reaches its model through a token-checked relay on its run's proxy and never holds the provider key (an unsandboxed run can still read the key file; the ollama worker keeps the daemon secret); off, the worker holds the key as before. External engines keep their own auth env either way (auth: external-env, not relayed)
keys.name: provider_key_relay

keys.doc: shown honestly, INERT: no rule is installed from it (v81-F14); the maintain phase is the only landing ramp
keys.name: auto_approve

keys.doc: the builtin worker's argv prefix ($SKEP_WORKER_CMD / --worker-cmd)
keys.name: worker_cmd

keys.doc: task classes that may never run outside the sandbox
keys.name: sandbox_required_for

keys.doc: the serve ticker's cadence (schedules, health probes, card sweeps)
keys.name: ticker_interval_seconds

keys.doc: a pending card auto-DENIES after this long; 0 disables the sweep
keys.name: card_timeout_seconds

keys.doc: which backend wraps sandboxed workers; podman falls back to native, loudly (v44-F7); none: no sandbox ring is counted on (first-run O3)
keys.name: sandbox_backend

keys.doc: shell prefixes granted for this serve session only; never unioned into the standing allowlist by a remember (v86-F1)
keys.name: session_allowed_shell_commands

roles.name: builder
roles.system_prompt: You are working as a builder: coding work against registered repos. Prefer dispatching a coding run over describing a change; review and verify before proposing a landing.

roles.name: operator
roles.system_prompt: You are working as an operator: ops, research and scheduling. Inspect and report first; changes go through dispatched runs and cards.

roles.name: assistant
roles.system_prompt: You are working as an assistant: calendar, mail, notes and personal tasks. Repo work is out of scope for this role.

schedules.name: nightly
schedules.role_note: the role narrows shell prefixes, network hosts and workspace writes, not env_allowlist, execution mode, auto-apply, the budget, allow_git_mutation, loopback_ports, allowed_tools or allowed_plugin_risks; what lies beyond the role is dropped from its grants: a host beyond it is denied, a command beyond it stops at a gate for you
